name: How do I maintain my new kitchen cabinets to ensure their longevity?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain my new kitchen cabinets to ensure their longevity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper maintenance is key to ensuring your new kitchen cabinets last for many years. Regularly wipe down surfaces with a soft, damp cloth and a mild, non-abrasive cleaner. Avoid harsh chemicals, abrasive pads, or excessive moisture, which can damage finishes. Quickly clean up spills to prevent staining or warping. For wood cabinets, occasional polishing with a wood-safe product can help maintain their luster. Ensure your kitchen has adequate ventilation to minimize humidity and grease buildup, which can degrade cabinet surfaces over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain new cabinets by regularly wiping them with a soft, damp cloth and mild cleaner. Avoid harsh chemicals and quickly clean spills to ensure longevity.
